explanation: Coraline was adapted from Neil Gaiman's 2002 novella. For it, Laika used 3D-printed faces, swapped frame by frame, to change the puppets' expressions.

claims.text: Laika made the stop-motion films Coraline (2009) and Kubo and the Two Strings (2016).
Aardman Animations, Pixar and DreamWorks Animation did not make Coraline or Kubo and the Two Strings.
Coraline is adapted from Neil Gaiman's novella Coraline, published in 2002.
For Coraline, Laika animated the puppets' expressions with replacement faces made on 3D printers.
